progression.name: New Mindset
progression.tagline: One day. One shift in perspective.
progression.description: Your first mission in personal transformation. A single day, a single mission — simple, profound, immediate. Discover how one moment of clarity can change everything.

progression.name: New Habit
progression.description: Science confirms it: 21 days are enough to lock in a new habit. Free, all 21 days — part of your on-ramp into Mara's programs before New Skills.

progression.name: New Skills
progression.description: Three months of daily missions to master something new — a skill, a field, a more capable version of yourself. Mara generates each day based on your real progress.

progression.name: New Body
progression.tagline: 180 days. A new body and mind.
progression.description: Six months of genuine physical and mental transformation. It's not a diet and it's not a standard fitness program — it's a real change of identity, built day by day through missions personalized by Mara.

progression.name: New Life
progression.description: A whole year of personalized daily missions. Career, relationships, health, purpose — all rebuilt step by step. In the end, you won't be an improved version of yourself. You'll be you, all over again.

progression.name: New You
progression.description: Three years. 1095 daily missions. The complete path from who you are now to who you can become. The most ambitious personal transformation program available — for those who have decided they truly want to change.

thematic.name: Morning Ritual
thematic.tagline: Transform your morning. Transform your life.
thematic.description: A 30-day program that helps you build a morning routine that fully belongs to you. Each day begins with a short, authentic, concrete mission.

thematic.name: Inner Work
thematic.description: A 90-day program of deep exploration. Missions that touch the most sensitive and most important aspects of your inner life. For the brave.

thematic.name: Creative Expression
thematic.tagline: Express yourself. Your art is your truth.
thematic.description: A 45-day program for those who want to express themselves authentically — through writing, drawing, photography, music. You don't have to be an artist. You have to be you.

thematic.name: Story of You
thematic.tagline: Write your story. Become the author of your life.
thematic.description: A 60-day program in which you build your first book — the book of your life. Every completed mission becomes a page. In the end you receive your book.

thematic.name: Legacy Builder
thematic.description: A 120-day program for real life change. Career, money, relationships, purpose. Concrete, difficult, transformative missions. Only for the determined.
